tip: Run a command instead of opening files

option.name: -a
tip: Attach to a daemon. Use -a for the current directory, -a NAME for a named daemon

option.name: --stdin
tip: Read content from stdin (alternative to using '-' as filename)

option.name: --safe
tip: Safe mode: skip init.ts AND all plugins (recovery from a bad config)

option.name: --log-file
tip: Path to log file for editor diagnostics

option.name: --event-log
tip: Enable event logging to the specified file

option.name: --no-restore
tip: Don't restore the previous workspace (hot-exit content of unsaved modified files and unnamed buffers is still restored so in-progress work is not lost)

option.name: --restore
tip: Force restore of the previous workspace, overriding 'editor.restore_previous_session = false' in the config

option.name: --no-upgrade-check
tip: Disable upgrade checking and anonymous telemetry
